The Apify Store API lists 71 NPI/NPPES actors sharing 114 users in 30 days (busiest 9, 45 at exactly 1), priced US$0.002–0.01 a record; the paid provider-data demand sits with scrapers of closed directories (Healthgrades, Zocdoc). Why a shelf and not another register: every gankdat-sibling spike since 10-17 (NPI, OFAC/EU, EU registers, VAT) parked on the same fact — 0 external calls — while the operation's only product that has taken money sold through a shelf that supplies its own buyers and billing (Figma Community). The Atlassian Marketplace is that shape with billing attached: Atlassian sells the app as commercial agent, collects sales tax/VAT and pays the partner within 30 days of the month its profit passes US$500 (developer FAQ, pricing-payment-billing). Fee, read from Atlassian's 2026 revenue-share post and the FAQ: Forge-only apps carry a 0 % commission on revenue earned from 1 January 2026 until a partner's lifetime Forge revenue reaches US$1 million; the standard Forge rate otherwise is 16 % (17 % from 1 October 2026), Connect 20 %→25 %. Forge hosting is free (forge-free-pricing-2025). The open question is the one that decides it: three 2026 developer-community threads ask whether an individual without a registered company can sell — a March 2026 post says Partner Verification wants a registered business entity, an August 2026 post says a Portuguese sole trader was verified and listed paid-via-Atlassian, the due-diligence page asks for 'a registration number and/or tax identification number', and the Turkey thread holds a Partner-team reply dated 2026-08-10 the search cut off. Demand is the second number: the Marketplace REST API 2 is keyless and lists per-app installs and users (community tip 45128; three Apify actors resell it), so the spike can count the small-vendor paid apps in a buildable niche instead of guessing. Promote (open an atlassian-apps venture queue, owner action: partner registration with the UTR) if an individual/sole trader can verify and ≥ 3 paid cloud apps from vendors with one or two listings show ≥ 200 installs at ≥ US$1/user/month in a niche buildable in ≤ 1 week; park if verification needs a company (then the parked limited-company idea is the trigger) or no such niche shows.
